transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.100 --> 00:00:01.500
If you live in Toronto or the G t,

00:00:01.501 --> 00:00:03.941
let me put you on to this affordable comfort food spot.

00:00:03.942 --> 00:00:06.221
You guys know the drill. This account is for people who love to eat.

00:00:06.222 --> 00:00:08.221
So hit that follow button for more food recommendation.

00:00:08.222 --> 00:00:10.381
This is Anna's hot spot. There are new restaurants.

00:00:10.382 --> 00:00:11.421
Let me tell you what to order.

00:00:11.422 --> 00:00:13.381
Just trust me, you have to get this combo.

00:00:13.382 --> 00:00:14.701
It's the Anna's Cookout combo.

00:00:14.702 --> 00:00:16.141
It comes with loaded fries,

00:00:16.142 --> 00:00:18.461
wing and a smash burger or a fried chicken sandwich

00:00:18.462 --> 00:00:20.181
and you get all this for just $23.

00:00:20.182 --> 00:00:23.021
I chose the Retro Paradise Fries for my combo and they were so good,

00:00:23.022 --> 00:00:24.941
surprisingly crispy for the amount of sauce that was on them.

00:00:24.942 --> 00:00:26.541
And you can pick whatever wing flavour you want.

00:00:26.542 --> 00:00:29.381
These wings are huge. I got the Chipotle Ranch Blaze ones.

00:00:29.382 --> 00:00:31.501
They were so good. And I got a double smash burger,

00:00:31.502 --> 00:00:33.221
which was definitely on the messy side.

00:00:33.222 --> 00:00:34.221
This was my boyfriend's order.

00:00:34.222 --> 00:00:35.661
He always thinks he orders better than me.

00:00:35.662 --> 00:00:37.381
So comment down below who you think ordered better.

00:00:37.382 --> 00:00:38.581
He got the hot shot wings

00:00:38.582 --> 00:00:40.541
and these were definitely more on the spicy side than mine.

00:00:40.542 --> 00:00:41.781
If you like Buffalo style heat,

00:00:41.782 --> 00:00:42.821
then these are perfect for you.

00:00:42.822 --> 00:00:44.361
He got the vintage curry fries

00:00:44.362 --> 00:00:46.461
and he got the Killer Bee fried chicken sandwich.

00:00:46.462 --> 00:00:47.821
I fear that he did, in fact,

00:00:47.822 --> 00:00:50.261
order better than me. This sandwich was unreal.

00:00:50.262 --> 00:00:53.661
It had this sweet honey glaze on that giant juicy Piece of chicken.

00:00:53.662 --> 00:00:54.421
It was too. Oh, God.

00:00:54.422 --> 00:00:56.701
I also got their biscoff milkshake and it was very light,

00:00:56.702 --> 00:00:59.021
which I love. But if you guys go here and you don't get the tiramisu,

00:00:59.022 --> 00:01:00.581
I will personally be so offended.

00:01:00.582 --> 00:01:02.621
I didn't even wanna take a bite cause I was already so full.

00:01:02.622 --> 00:01:03.901
But I could not stop eating this.

00:01:03.902 --> 00:01:06.101
It was that good. It had a very balanced flavour.

00:01:06.102 --> 00:01:06.941
Definitely check them out,

00:01:06.942 --> 00:01:09.499
addresses on the screen and I'll see you in the next food review.

description: Is @Urban Planet the MOST affordable clothing store in the mall? @Urban Planet X Charlotte Russe #urbanplanet #affordablefashion #mensfashion #mensclothing #affordableclothes
transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.020 --> 00:00:01.900
Go to the most affordable clothing store in the mall.

00:00:01.901 --> 00:00:04.501
Urban Planet. This used to be a Forever 21 rip.

00:00:04.502 --> 00:00:05.941
This sale section goes crazy.

00:00:05.942 --> 00:00:07.741
Five dollar jerseys here and there.

00:00:07.742 --> 00:00:08.741
Look at all these sweaters.

00:00:08.742 --> 00:00:11.021
Summer's coming. They got the shorts for five bucks.

00:00:11.022 --> 00:00:13.981
Five dollar tees. I got a bunch of jorts right here for ten bucks.

00:00:13.982 --> 00:00:15.881
And a whole section with the ten dollar jeans.

00:00:15.882 --> 00:00:18.741
All these shirts being $5 is absolutely insane.

00:00:18.742 --> 00:00:19.581
Okay, Urban Planet.

00:00:19.582 --> 00:00:21.221
This makes me miss Forever 21.

00:00:21.222 --> 00:00:23.941
This looks fire in here. They got some nice jerseys up here.

00:00:23.942 --> 00:00:27.175
Anything is possible if you're balling on a budget. Go to Urban Planet.
